title: operations-bff command routing shapes
description: COMMAND intent request and acceptance receipt. The BFF routes intent unchanged and returns the backend acceptance verbatim; acceptance is never completion. Actor identity is derived server side from the session and never supplied by the browser.

command_type.description: Backend-owned command name; the BFF assigns it no semantics.

expected_revision.description: Revision the user acted on, for stale-state rejection by the backend.

parameters.description: Backend command payload forwarded unmodified; validated by the owning Command API.

outcome.description: Backend acceptance result, verbatim. There is no completed or confirmed value: canonical effects arrive as events through the stream.
